Afterglow System Afterglow Design System · October 2026 06

The rule that can be checked

The brand's central idea is a sentence about mood that nobody can act on. This is its usable form.

The interaction rule

No state change brightens.

Hover, focus and active deepen or shift hue, and never lighten. Nothing fades up to a brighter value. That is checkable in a diff, which is why it is written this way and not as a sentence about mood.

Never

Stage 3 or stage 4 as a letterform. Both fail every text floor on the void.

Never

Stage 3 or stage 4 on a surface step. Both fall further there than on the void, to 1.88:1 and 1.00:1.

Never

Muted on a stage colour. It fails on all four.

Always

Stage 1 for a mark, a rule or an accent on the void, at 9.97:1.

Where the rules stop

Cart and checkout are plain and fast, exactly as the voice is. The deepening discipline serves browsing and gets out of the way where clarity beats mood. Applied to a payment form it would make the form worse.
